method: Grounding DINO detection + DINOv2 cropped-reference cosine similarity

settings.selection: highest detector confidence after per-query NMS; not highest similarity
settings.crop: tight clamped bounding box; no segmentation or extra padding
settings.resize: aspect-preserving fit into 224x224, RGB (124,116,104) padding; no center crop
settings.similarity: raw cosine, not accuracy or probability; no calibrated cutoff

sanity_checks.note: Sanity checks only; different object categories do not calibrate same-instance identity.

limits: No VQA, human ratings or generative judge. Similarity is not exact-object accuracy. Detection can miss small/occluded objects or confuse categories. Boxes retain background. Location, ownership, counts and fine attributes are not established by cosine similarity.
